question: What will be the average daily mean temperature in Mexico City over the 7 days ending September 23, 2026, in degrees Celsius?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the mean of the daily mean 2-metre air temperatures from 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-23 at latitude 19.43, longitude -99.13 (Mexico City), from the ERA5 reanalysis as served by the Open-Meteo historical weather API (archive-api.open-meteo.com), in degrees Celsius.

I've pulled the ERA5 numbers and checked each year's figures, so here is the write-up.

# Mexico City, average daily mean temperature for Sept 17-23, 2026 (ERA5 via Open-Meteo)

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the Open-Meteo archive API: `archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=19.43&longitude=-99.13&daily=temperature_2m_mean`. I queried it directly. [Open-Meteo archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=19.43&longitude=-99.13&start_date=2026-08-20&end_date=2026-09-09&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=auto)
- 2026-09-09: the latest values shown for the grid point are Sep 3: 17.9, Sep 4: 18.5, Sep 5: 17.8, Sep 6: 16.5, Sep 7: 16.3, Sep 8: 16.9, Sep 9: 16.7 °C. That makes the 7-day mean for Sep 3-9 about 17.2 °C. One caveat: ERA5 normally runs about 5 days behind, so on Sep 9 itself the last few days may not yet have been final.
- 2026-08-20 to 09-09: the 21-day mean is about 16.97 °C. Daily values ranged from 15.5 (Aug 24) to 18.5 (Sep 4). [Open-Meteo archive](https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?latitude=19.43&longitude=-99.13&start_date=2026-08-20&end_date=2026-09-09&daily=temperature_2m_mean&timezone=auto)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-09-09: nothing is settled yet. The resolution window (Sep 17-23) starts 8 days after forecasts close.
- I could not get an archived Open-Meteo forecast issued around Sep 9. The live forecast endpoint only returns current output, which doesn't apply here.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-09: Grupo Animal reported rain and cloudy skies for CDMX and Edomex. [Grupo Animal](https://grupoanimal.mx/sociedad/clima-septiembre-lluvias-nublado-cdmx-edomex)
- 2026-09-08: Grupo Animal reported light rain and cloudy skies in CDMX. [Grupo Animal](https://grupoanimal.mx/sociedad/pronostico-del-clima-en-cdmx-martes-8-de-septiembre)
- 2026-09-07: rain alert for CDMX, with a forecast low of 13-15 °C and high of 22-24 °C. [Grupo Animal](https://grupoanimal.mx/sociedad/pronostico-del-clima-en-cdmx-lunes-7-de-septiembre)
- 2026-09-06 to 09: the SIAP/SMN agrometeorological bulletin forecast heavy to very heavy rain, including in the Valle de México. It linked the rain to tropical waves 26 and 27. [SIAP PDF](https://www.gob.mx/cms/uploads/attachment/file/854888/SIAP-PronosticoAgrometeorologico.pdf)

[Milenio](https://www.milenio.com/el-clima/en-que-mes-habra-mas-ciclones-tropicales-huracanes-en-mexico-este-2026); [Azteca Jalisco](https://www.aztecajalisco.com/clima/septiembre-llega-con-alerta-cuantos-ciclones-podrian-formarse-este-mes/)

Summary of those 11 years:
- **Average and spread:** the mean is about 16.97 °C, with a standard deviation of about 0.65 °C. The range is 16.00 (2016) to 17.87 (2017).
- **Last 5 years (2021-2025):** the mean is about 17.08 °C, with no clear trend. Three of the last three years came in at 17.37 or higher.
- **Day-to-day swings:** individual days in this window vary by roughly ±1.5 °C. Rainy spells (for example 2016 and 2024 dips to about 14.6-14.9) pull the weekly mean down, and drier stretches push it up (for example 2023 late-window days of 18-19).
- **Recent 2026 conditions:** the Sep 3-9 mean of about 17.2 and the late-August-to-early-September mean of about 17.0 are both close to the climatology.
- **Range check:** the question's 16.0-18.5 range covers every year from 2015 to 2025.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on this question.
- I found no quantitative expert forecast for Sep 17-23, 2026 published by Sep 9. Media forecasts around Sep 7-9 gave typical CDMX highs of 22-25 °C and lows of 13-15 °C. Those imply daily means of roughly 17-19 °C at the station level, but ERA5 grid values tend to come in lower.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The rainy season is still active and tropical waves keep arriving. Persistent cloud and rain, or a tropical cyclone remnant near central Mexico, would cool daily means. Drier breaks would warm them.
- Mid-to-late September is around when the first cold fronts and the seasonal decline in rain begin.
- The window ends Sep 23. ERA5 data for it should be in the archive about 5 days later, near the Sep 29 resolution date.
